defects.description: Scheduled disposal bypasses the handle's exactly-once guard and capacity restoration.

trigger.input: Capture scheduled callbacks and release calls; acquire, close the handle, then execute its callback.

defects.why_missed: The suite has no scheduler or release adapter, so callbacks are never executed.

defects.description: All tenants share one accounting key, so one tenant consumes another's capacity.

trigger.input: Acquire two handles for alpha at quota=2, then acquire a handle for beta.

defects.why_missed: Each existing desk instance exercises only one tenant; no simultaneous tenants share a desk.
